This FloPlast square external stop end, in a robust black 114mm uPVC construction, provides a reliable and attractive finish for square gutter systems. Designed for external use, its rectilinear profile offers a clean aesthetic for various properties. This solution is ideal for both new build projects and refurbishment applications, ensuring compatibility with most major manufacturer guttering. Featuring pre-lubricated gutter seals and a pre-fitted retaining clip system, it simplifies installation and secures the gutter run effectively.
